title: Design: Row menu of the default term greys Deactivate
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop uses Net 30 as the default, and you compare its row menu with the design.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Net 30 is the default for new customers and is held by at least one customer.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p1-08-row-menu-the-current-default.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the Net 30 row.
  2. Hover "Deactivate".
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Net 30 row turns light grey and a small menu opens with "Move Customers" and "Deactivate", Deactivate greyed; there is no "Make Default for New Customers".
  • Step 2: a dark grey box opens to the left of the menu, on two lines: "This is your default for new customers" and "Pick another default first." (as in ct-p1-08-row-menu-the-current-default.png).
  • Step 3: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-N4: “The current default never shows "Make Default for New Customers"; its "Deactivate" and, for a term the shop created, "Delete Credit Term" show blocked with the default reason (S2-R1).”
  • S2-R1: “Each row's "⋯" menu shows only the items that apply to that term, in this order. An item that applies but is blocked shows greyed out and does nothing when clicked; hovering it shows the reason.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover a blocked Deactivate or Delete Credit Term on the default | "This is your default for new customers" / "Pick another default first." | Tooltip on hover, item greyed”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
